openings.claim: Clamp closure may disturb datum seating. A supplied elastic loop per incumbent pocket, biasing its rod toward corner and insertion stop during closure, could preserve insertion position. Keep pockets, stops and captive hardware; remove preload before return checks to prevent masking failure.
openings.discriminator: Rival: pocket compliance explains poor return. Decreased closure-induced pointer movement with preload, then similar loaded deflection, favors disturbed seating. Comparable closure movement or return scatter defeats this branch; equal excessive loaded drift favors inadequate pocket stiffness. Predictions remain unverified.
openings.probe: Build one configuration within 100 minutes; check 90 mm cube, hand-only operation, cord-retained hardware, no rod drilling, adhesive or permanent marks. Within twenty minutes run twelve exchanges, six per rod position, alternating ordinary seating and preloaded closure; replace smaller rod with 18 mm for its last two exchanges. Record pointer before/after tightening, after removing preload, and duration. Apply four ten-second 10 N loads across procedures and rod sizes. Check every final return and loaded position against 2 mm circle; fail exchanges taking forty seconds or more or freeing components.
openings.uncertainty: Incumbent geometry must fit six plywood pieces and eight bolts; no extra hardware available. Supplied loops must provide directional preload inside envelope without obstructing exchange or marking rods. Ruler/target must resolve closure shifts; precision and plywood stiffness remain unknown. Only three exchanges per procedure per rod: diagnostic, not independent complete validation of both procedures. Capacity or measurement failure defeats probe; no deployment performance established.

lineage.reason: Retains closure-disturbed seating hypothesis, temporary preload intervention, compliance rival, comparison and defeat conditions, uncertain fit, constrained diagnostic and feasibility caveats.

decision: Test only if incumbent geometry and loop routing pass fabrication checks; this diagnostic cannot establish the required five-exchange performance for both procedures.
